meta.brief: 10 homepage design directions for shortlisting. Preserve Angel Face brand equity; lead with ultrasound, regenerative, natural results, Stoneham priority.

competitors.name: Precision Nurse Aesthetics
competitors.notes: Direct Stoneham competitor. Nurse-led, precision positioning, PDGF/microneedling, strong founder page, Book Now primary.

competitors.name: Cosmetic Laser Solutions
competitors.notes: Device-heavy (laser, RF, ultrasound systems). Clinical tech language. Competes on advanced facial rejuvenation suite.

competitors.name: Seaport Medspa
competitors.notes: Multi-location, Top % Galderma/Allergan badges, commission-free providers, PRF/EZGel. Polished medical brand.

competitors.name: Newton Medical Aesthetics
competitors.notes: Physician-led boutique luxury. Natural/refined language. Strong injectables education.

competitors.name: Boemy Wellness
competitors.notes: Nurse-led wellness studio hybrid. Injectables + laser + IV. Warm unhurried tone.

competitors.name: MD Beauty Boston
competitors.notes: Personal NP-founder story site. Boutique, consult-led, artfully done positioning.

comps.name: Clinical Mist
comps.tagline: Cool clinical calm with rose accent
comps.why: Matches ultrasound/safety story without looking like a deal spa. Differentiates from Precision Nurse’s warmer precision brand.
comps.vsMarket: More clinical-cool than Seaport’s medical blue; quieter than laser clinics.

comps.name: Soft Blush Atelier
comps.why: Owns feminine natural-beauty emotion from reviews (lips, first-timers, comfort).
comps.vsMarket: Closer to boutique Newton/Wellesley luxury than Stoneham nurse competitors.

comps.name: Regenerative Lab
comps.why: Leads with the rare MA ultrasound differentiator and regenerative claim.
comps.vsMarket: Counters Cosmetic Laser Solutions device story with Jenny’s ultrasound-guided injectables.

comps.name: Founder Forward
comps.why: Reviews repeatedly name Jenny. Trust is personal — mirror Precision Nurse’s founder-forward pattern, but for Jenny.
comps.vsMarket: Same category move as Precision Nurse / MD Beauty founder pages.

comps.name: Dark Luxe Clinic
comps.why: Premium pricing posture vs deal spas; feels exclusive without neon gimmicks.
comps.vsMarket: Darker than most Boston med spa sites — stands out in a pastel-heavy SERP.

comps.name: Gallery White
comps.why: Maximum brand signal, minimum clutter. OCD-friendly clarity for Jenny’s structured taste.
comps.vsMarket: Strips away the busy service grids common on competitor homepages.

comps.name: Booking First
comps.why: Direct response to soft season — calendar fill before brand poetry.
comps.vsMarket: Matches Precision Nurse Book Now urgency with regenerative consult CTA.

comps.name: Education Magazine
comps.why: Leans into Jenny’s education/safety differentiator and comparison-spiral antidote (substance over hype).
comps.vsMarket: More editorial than Seaport’s recognition badges approach.

comps.name: Wellness Flagship
comps.why: Visualizes Phase 4 vision (facials/lasers/hyperbaric) without abandoning injectables now.
comps.vsMarket: Overlaps Boemy wellness hybrid territory — use only if rebrand gate allows umbrella story.

comps.name: North Shore Neighbor
comps.why: Stoneham-first demand engine from the marketing plan. Local, friendly, elevated.
comps.vsMarket: Speaks directly against Precision Nurse’s Stoneham presence with neighborhood warmth.
